insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: 2 Lacs to 6 Crores (Base Sum Insured options listed); Sum Insured may include Base Sum Insured + Super Reload + Super Credit (+ Cancer Booster if opted)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent: Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actual costs up to the sum insured without any category restrictions or capping. This means you can choose any room type without facing room rent linked deductions.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days before hospitalization for the same condition are covered. This longer pre-hospitalization period helps cover diagnostic and treatment costs leading to hospitalization.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured ("super Reload"), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: If your base sum insured is exhausted, the insurer reloads the sum insured up to the base amount unlimited times in the policy year, subject to conditions. This provides extra coverage beyond the base sum insured for multiple claims.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: Super Credit (Increases Irrespective of Claim): 100% of Base Sum Insured per year, up to 500% of Base Sum Insured (up to Max of 3 Cr under this benefit)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: The no-claim bonus increases your sum insured by 100% of the base sum insured each year even if you make claims, up to a maximum of 500%. This means your sum insured grows continuously without resetting after claims.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+); also Section C.4 Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver)
great.explanation: Non-medical consumables like gloves, masks, and syringes listed in Annexure I are covered if Claim Protect is active. This reduces common out-of-pocket expenses during hospitalization.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization of the Insured Person
great.explanation: Home-based treatment that would otherwise require hospitalization is covered if it lasts at least 3 consecutive days. This allows coverage for treatment at home under specified conditions.

great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses incurred towards treatment... arising out of Hospitalization for a Bariatric Surgery during the Policy Period subject to the conditions that needs to be fulfilled as per Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered when medical criteria specified in the policy are met. This provides coverage for obesity-related surgical treatment.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Modern Procedures / Treatments: Actuals up to Sum Insured for listed procedures
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: Modern medical procedures listed in the policy are covered at actual costs up to the sum insured without separate sub-limits. This ensures better coverage for advanced treatments.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness-related expenses are excluded for the first 30 days except for accidents. This is a standard waiting period in health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Treatment for specified illnesses and procedures is excluded for the first 24 months of coverage. This is a common waiting period for certain conditions.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: Not mentioned in the provided text.
bad.reference: Document extract provided (no explicit Restore/Restore+ benefit clause found)
bad.explanation: No restore benefit is mentioned, so the sum insured is not replenished after a claim. This means you cannot restore your sum insured separately from the super reload feature.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. While good, this does not exceed 180 days, so it is not best-in-class.

bad.name: Co-pay (Optional)
bad.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... discount of 10%... If the Insured Person takes treatment... other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim
bad.reference: Section C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: A 10% co-pay applies only if you opt for the PPN discount and go outside the preferred network. This is an optional co-pay, not mandatory.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment: means a cost sharing requirement... (definition provided).
bad.reference: Section B.1.10 Co-Payment (definition); Section C.15.5 shows co-pay only under optional cover
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-payment but does not clearly state if the base plan has any mandatory co-pay. Only optional co-pay under PPN discount is mentioned, so the default co-pay status is unclear.
